subject: Champion onboarding & MAP: Q4 commitments and escalation path
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@ardenthealth.com>, Daniel Hayes <daniel.hayes@ardenthealth.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 08 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Champion onboarding & MAP: Q4 commitments and escalation path

Hi Sarah (and team),

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great conversation. I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to align exec sponsorship, evaluation milestones, and close timeline for Q4. Our goal is to have an exec-level commitment and procurement signal by the end of November so we can schedule Dedicated capacity for your pilot in early December.

I've attached a draft MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short SOC2 evidence checklist we typically share with healthcare customers. High-level asks in the MAP:
- Roles & owners: Exec sponsor (VP/CTO), Technical champion, Procurement lead
- Milestones: Technical eval (2 weeks), Security review (3 weeks), Procurement/legal (2 weeks)
- Escalation path: VP → CTO → Redwood Sales Director (for timeline risk)

Can you please:
1) Confirm who will be the executive sponsor on your side (VP or CTO).
2) Share preferred availability for a 30-minute MAP kickoff this week or early next week so we can walk the plan with your champion and procurement.

CCing our internal leads Markus and Laura (technical and success), who will run the eval plan and procurement coordination.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-Checklist.pdf (doc)

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@ardenthealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@ardenthealth.com
Date: Thu, 08 Nov 2028 12:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Champion onboarding & MAP: Q4 commitments and escalation path

Thanks Mina — appreciate the clear plan and the materials. I looped in procurement (procurement@ardenthealth.com) and our CTO, Daniel Hayes. A couple of quick notes: 

- Timeline: November close is aggressive but possible if security review and procurement move in parallel.
- SOC2 evidence: The checklist is helpful; procurement will need the SOC2 report and a short security questionnaire.
- Exec sponsor: I will be the initial champion but will ask Daniel to be the formal exec sponsor (VP/CTO level).

Can you hold a 30-minute kickoff on Monday (Nov 12) at 11:00am PT? That works for our procurement and engineering leads.

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Liu
Director of Digital Innovation | Ardent Health
sarah.liu@ardenthealth.com

Perfect — Monday 11:00am PT is locked on our calendar. Thank you, Sarah.

A few prep notes for the kickoff (attached MAP version v1):
- Mina (Redwood) — Exec alignment + MAP owner (runs weekly MAP check-ins)
- Markus Klein — Technical lead (integration, model selection, perf targets)
- Laura Bennett — Customer success (pilot ops, SLOs, go-live checklist)

Daniel — thanks for joining. A couple of quick items where exec alignment helps:
1) Decision authority: confirm whether you or a delegate will sign procurement for the pilot.
2) Quarterly outcomes: if we secure approval, the pilot target is to demonstrate a 40% reduction in inference latency for your top NLP workload and a cost estimate for production by end of Q4.
3) Escalation: if timelines slip, Sarah will escalate to Daniel; if the timeline continues to be at risk, we will engage Redwood Sales Director (Eskil Bates) as the next step.

I attached the SOC2-Checklist.pdf and our standard MAP workbook. Markus will follow up in the kickoff with a short integration checklist and target test queries.

Next steps:
- Monday 11:00am PT kickoff (30 min) — invite has been sent
- Pre-read: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx and SOC2-Checklist.pdf

Looking forward — Mina

--
Mina Haddad

Thanks, Mina and Sarah — I reviewed the MAP pre-read briefly and I support moving forward.

I'll be the exec sponsor for the engagement and will delegate procurement sign-off to our procurement lead for the pilot contract. I expect a short exec review on Nov 20 to confirm budget and timeline.

Appreciate the clear escalation path — if anything threatens the Nov close we'll surface it early. Looking forward to the kickoff now.

Regards,
Daniel Hayes
CTO | Ardent Health
